title: Page 7
content_zh:
是时候回报萧王这几年的所作所为了。

丈夫没有回答，柳悠悠也没有再问。

窗外的光透过窗纱射进来，在唐忠信身上镀了个金色的轮廓，所以，柳悠悠干脆也不看书了，而是单手支颐，垂眸专心地欣赏男人的睡颜。

大哥下手有点儿狠啊，相公原本英俊的脸上青紫交加，比早上擦药的时候感觉更惨，不过能把怒气发泄岀来也好，免得跟萧王一样，牛角尖钻久了就把自己弄成了一个疯子。

是的，萧王在柳悠悠眼里就是个疯子。

萧王的伤垫情况终于还是泄露了岀来。

那一场大火毁掉了萧王的半张脸，俊美无俦、犹如仙姿的一张脸就只剩下了半边，这可真是报应！

在听到这消息时，唐忠信差点儿当场拍手称快，但想一想，又觉得还不如干脆把萧王烧死呢。

因为这把火虽然毁掉了他凭借的先天优势，可他还是活了下来，对于一个早就已经想法扭曲、行事偏执的人来说，这样的遭遇恐怕只会更加激起他的暴戾与狠辣。

这让唐忠信暗暗警惕了起来，命令手下要看牢了，一定得看牢了萧王，绝对不能再岀什么意外。

一头困兽是疯狂的，破坏力也一定是惊人的。

可是，这样一个在唐忠信看来极度危险的人，暂时却没有办法对他按律制裁，只因萧王之节的名声实在是太好了，皇上也得顾虑悠悠众口，虽然皇棋有查到证据，可那些证据有许多都牵扯到官员后宅，实在也是没办法拿到人前说。

为此，唐忠信暗地里加强了对妻子的保护。毕竟萧王曾经打过他家小悠的主意，谁也不知道他疯起来会不会又找上小悠。

柳悠悠倒是没有怎么担心，她平日深居简出，分家之后更是不出门了，是想要对她下手，机会也是不好找的。

不过时间一天天过去，萧王一直没有异动。

唐忠信跟柳悠悠都不觉得萧王会就此沉寂，倒没放柲警惕，而就在这个时候，柳悠悠收到了相府送来的消息——

关舜华有了身孕，在成亲四个月后，此时会公布喜讯，已经是度过了安胎的头三个月，而关义成夫妇为此邀请一些关系紧密的亲戚朋友一起吃个酒。

这个事实让唐忠信很是羡慕嫉妒恨了一番，对于相府送来的信也有点看不顺眼。

柳悠悠忍不住笑着摇头，阖上撒着金粉的请帖，随手放到了石桌上，「要一起去瞧一瞧吗？」

他不想去，但他还是回答了这么一个字——

「去。」

他心底总有隐隐的不安，他知道那是来自对萧王的忌惮，以及他内心深处害怕失去妻子的担忧。

「看样子，明天不是个好天气啊。」时序已经进入腊月，天气冷得很，现在是傍晩时分，甚至飘起了雪花，唐忠信看着凉亭外的雪，语含深意的说。

柳悠悠站在他的身边，也看着飘雪的天空，语气淡淡地道：「马车要赶慢一点了。」

随着他们成亲已久，已经揪岀内应，夫妻相处情形便从一开始的貌合神离、同床异梦慢慢转变成现在的和谐，丝毫没有引起旁人的怀疑，大家都只庆幸唐忠信浪子回头了。

这其中当然是不包括关舜华的，她跟柳悠悠灵魂互换过，隐约已经猜到了柳悠悠其实就是外面风传的那个贪欢楼的花魁娘子。

她虽然并不太明白内情，却凊楚地知道这些事不能深究，于是便装糊涂了。

而她也因此不论外面的传言如何说唐忠信他们夫妻感情不好，都不以为然，她一点儿都不怀疑唐三公子对义姊的一片真心，就如同她不怀疑自己对丈夫的爱一样，反倒对于他们这样做戏给外人看，仿佛真的婚后才感情逐渐变好、不让旁人看出端倪而很是佩服。

唐忠信伸手将妻子揽进怀中，顺手替她扰了扰斗篷，口气带了些许的纵容，「你高兴就好。」连拿话哄他一哄都不愿，甚至还故意要气他一气，他真是惯坏了她。

柳悠悠靠进他怀里时，耳语似地说：「明知道不能不去的。」真是幼稚。

唐忠信为之失笑，他当然知道不能不去，就是忍不住跟她撒撒娇罢了，不过可惜她不买帐。

「外面冷，咱们回屋吧。」

「嗯。」

唐忠信拥着她回了屋，掀开珠帘了内室，自己动手帮她解了斗篷搭到一边，然后又搂着她坐到了靠窗的软榻上。

柳悠悠喜欢丈夫身上传来的热度，这样的季节窝在这样阔而安全的怀抱里实在是惬意幸福得很。

唐忠信搂着她半躺在榻上，拿了毯子盖住两个人，然后拿过小几上的书随手翻了翻。

并不是什么诗词赋、四书五经，而是一本可能在文人士子眼里有些低俗的话本小说，小悠喜欢看，时不时就会买新的，他有时便也信手翻上一翻。

没想到今天随手一翻就翻到了好东西，他津津有味地看了起来，看完了还把书凑到妻子眼前，「看看怎么样。」

柳悠悠看了两眼，脸就忍不住有些发红，抬手打了他两下。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

唐忠信低声愉悦地笑了起来，伸手把她往自己怀里提了提，然后手顺着她的衣襟探了进去，她同时闭上眼迎向了他俯下来的唇。

就在两个人吻得难分难解，互相爱抚到衣衫凌乱，眼看就要控制不住的时候，屋外却传来小苹的声音——

「老爷，有客人登门，管家请您去。」

唐忠信稳了稳心神，努力让自己的声音听起来很正常，「知道了。」

柳悠悠心中也有些失望，微微抿了唇帮他整理衣服。

唐忠信凑到她耳边轻笑，「我去去就来。」

「哼。」柳信抬头就在他胸前捶了一记，横了他一眼，却很是妖媚。

临走前，唐忠信又伸手摸了她的脸一把，才心满意足地出去会客了。

柳悠悠伸手摸了摸被他摸过的地方，笑着摇头，歪到榻上拿了书继续看，当然她跳过了那段让人脸红心跳的描述。

然而庆祝关舜华有喜的宴会当天，气氛却不是很愉快，因为萧王顶着他那半张被烧毁的脸不请自来。

做为当朝王爷、当今圣上同父异母的兄弟，即使关义成身为丞相，也得给他几分薄面，心里再对此人不喜，也只能笑脸相迎。

而萧王的出现让唐忠信心头一跳，提高了警觉。

可是最后还是出事了，出事的不是男客的外院这边，而是内院。

关舜华小产了，萧王侧妃是造成这一切的元凶。

萧王侧妃一直是个影子一样的存在，在萧王与萧王妃那段情深似海的爱情故事中，萧王侧妃仿佛只是一个龙套。

所以谁也没料到，就是这样一个让人忽视的女子，会做出这样恶毒的事情来。

收到消息的萧王，挟着一身怒气进了相府后院。

看到自家王爷之后，萧王侧妃哭着扑上来诉说自己不是的，可惜，她却没能得到萧王的庇护，而是被他直接一脚踹飞在地。

在萧王侧妃挂着泪水、一脸难以置信看过去时，萧王顺手抽了身边侍卫的腰刀便给了她一刀。

在生命飞速流逝的那转瞬之间，萧王侧妃脑中闪过了许多的东西，有王爷对她的温言细语、王爷对她的疼爱，王爷对王妃只是表面深情，暗地里却给她灌下了绝子汤……

她一直相信王爷其实爱的是自己，可是现在她突然发现王爷根本从来就没有爱过她，她不过是他利用的一枚棋子罢了。
content_en:
It's time to repay King Xiao for what he has done in the past few years.

The husband didn't answer, and Liu Youyou didn't ask again.

The light from the window came in through the window screen and cast a golden outline on Tang Zhongxin's body. Therefore, Liu Youyou stopped reading at all. Instead, she rested her forehead with one hand and lowered her eyes to admire the man's sleeping face intently.

The eldest brother's attack was a bit harsh. My husband's originally handsome face was covered with bruises and he felt worse than when he applied the medicine in the morning. But it was good to vent his anger, lest he become a lunatic like Prince Xiao, who had been in trouble for too long.

Yes, Prince Xiao is a lunatic in Liu Youyou's eyes.

The condition of King Xiao's injury was finally revealed.

That fire destroyed half of Prince Xiao's face, and only half of his handsome, fairy-like face was left. This was really retribution!

When he heard the news, Tang Zhongxin almost clapped his hands and cheered on the spot, but after thinking about it, he thought it would be better to burn King Xiao to death.

Because although the fire destroyed the innate advantages he relied on, he still survived. For a person who had already distorted his thoughts and acted paranoid, such an encounter would probably only arouse his violence and ruthlessness even more.

This made Tang Zhongxin secretly vigilant and ordered his men to keep a close eye on Prince Xiao. There must be no more surprises.

A trapped beast is crazy and its destructive power must be astonishing.

However, for such a person who was considered extremely dangerous by Tang Zhongxin, there was currently no way to punish him according to law. This was just because the reputation of King Xiao's Festival was so good, and the emperor had to worry about the public opinion. Although Huangqi had found evidence, many of the evidence involved the officials' back houses, and there was really no way to tell it in front of others.

For this reason, Tang Zhongxin secretly strengthened his protection of his wife.After all, King Xiao once had an idea for his Xiaoyou. No one knows if he will find Xiaoyou again if he gets crazy.

Liu Youyou wasn't too worried. She usually lived in seclusion, and even after the separation, she didn't go out. He wanted to attack her, but it was hard to find the opportunity.

However, time passed day by day, and Prince Xiao remained motionless.

Neither Tang Zhongxin nor Liu Youyou thought that Prince Xiao would fall silent, so they did not put down their guard. At this moment, Liu Youyou received the news from the Prime Minister's Mansion——

Guan Shunhua is pregnant. The good news will be announced four months after the wedding. The first three months of pregnancy have already passed. For this reason, Guan Yicheng and his wife invited some close relatives and friends to have a drink together.

This fact made Tang Zhongxin very envious and jealous, and he also disliked the letter sent by the Prime Minister's Mansion.

Liu Youyou couldn't help but smile and shake her head, closed the invitation sprinkled with gold powder, and put it on the stone table, "Want to go and take a look together?"

He didn't want to go, but he still answered with this word——

"Go."

There was always a faint uneasiness in his heart. He knew that it came from his fear of Prince Xiao and his deep fear of losing his wife.

"It looks like the weather will not be good tomorrow." It has already entered the twelfth lunar month, and the weather is very cold. It is now evening, and snowflakes are even falling. Tang Zhongxin looked at the snow outside the pavilion and said with deep meaning.

Liu Youyou stood beside him, looking at the snowy sky, and said in a calm tone: "The carriage needs to go slower."

As they have been married for a long time and have developed internal relationships, the relationship between the couple has slowly changed from the initial appearance of being in harmony with each other, sharing the same bed but having different dreams, to the current harmony, without arousing the slightest suspicion from others. Everyone is just glad that Tang Zhongxin's prodigal son has turned back.

Of course, Guan Shunhua was not included in this. She had exchanged souls with Liu Youyou, and she had vaguely guessed that Liu Youyou was actually the oiran from Tanhuanlou that was rumored outside.

Although she didn't quite understand what was going on, she knew clearly that these things couldn't be explored in detail, so she pretended to be confused.

And for this reason, she didn't take it seriously regardless of the rumors outside that Tang Zhongxin and his wife were not in a good relationship. She didn't doubt Mr. Tang San's sincerity towards his sworn sister at all, just like she didn't doubt her love for her husband. On the contrary, she admired them for doing this to show it to outsiders, as if their relationship gradually got better after marriage without letting others notice.

Tang Zhongxin stretched out his hand to take his wife into his arms, and ruffled the cloak for her. His tone was a little indulgent, "As long as you are happy." She was not even willing to coax him with words, and even deliberately wanted to make him angry. He really spoiled her.

When Liu Youyou leaned into his arms, she whispered, "I knew I had to go." It was so childish.

Tang Zhongxin laughed at this, of course he knew he had to go, he just couldn't help but act coquettishly with her, but it was a pity that she didn't buy it.

"It's cold outside, let's go back inside."

"Yeah."

Tang Zhongxin hugged her back to the house, opened the bead curtain into the inner room, helped her untie her cloak and put it aside, then hugged her and sat on the soft couch by the window.

Liu Youyou likes the warmth coming from her husband. In this season, it is really comfortable and happy to be in such a wide and safe embrace.

Tang Zhongxin hugged her and lay half on the couch, covered the two of them with a blanket, then took the book on the small table and flipped through it.

It's not some poetry or the Four Books and Five Classics, but a novel that may be a little vulgar in the eyes of literati. Xiaoyou likes to read it and buys new ones from time to time. He sometimes flips through it.

Unexpectedly, he found something good when he casually flipped through it today. He read it with gusto. After reading it, he put the book in front of his wife and said, "Let's see how it goes."

Liu Youyou glanced twice, her face couldn't help but turn red, and she raised her hand to hit him twice.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

Tang Zhongxin laughed happily in a low voice, stretched out his hand to lift her into his arms, and then inserted his hand along the skirt of her clothes. At the same time, she closed her eyes and faced his lips.

Just when the two of them were kissing each other inseparably, caressing each other until their clothes were messy, and just when they were about to lose control, Xiao Ping's voice came from outside the room——

"Sir, there are guests coming to our door. The butler will ask you to come."

Tang Zhongxin calmed down and tried to make his voice sound normal, "I understand."

Liu Youyou was also a little disappointed, and she pursed her lips slightly to help him arrange his clothes.

Tang Zhongxin leaned into her ear and chuckled, "I'll come as soon as I go."

"Hmph." Liu Xin raised his head and punched him in the chest, giving him a sideways look, but it was very seductive.

Before leaving, Tang Zhongxin reached out and touched her face again, and then went out to meet the guests with satisfaction.

Liu Youyou reached out and touched the place he touched, shook her head with a smile, leaned on the couch, picked up the book and continued reading. Of course, she skipped the description that made people blush and heartbeat.

However, on the day of the banquet to celebrate Guan Shunhua's happiness, the atmosphere was not very pleasant, because King Xiao showed up uninvited with half of his burned face.

As the half-brother of the current prince and the current emperor, even if Guan Yicheng becomes the prime minister, he has to be treated with some kindness. No matter how unhappy he is in his heart, he can only greet him with a smile.

The appearance of King Xiao made Tang Zhongxin jump in his head and heightened his vigilance.

But something happened in the end, not in the male guest's outer courtyard, but in the inner courtyard.

Guan Shunhua had a miscarriage, and Prince Xiao's concubine was the culprit.

The concubine of Prince Xiao has always been a shadow-like existence. In the love story of Prince Xiao and Princess Xiao, the concubine of Prince Xiao seems to be just a supporting role.

So no one expected that such a neglected woman would do such a vicious thing.

After receiving the news, King Xiao entered the backyard of the Prime Minister's Mansion full of anger.

After seeing her prince, Prince Xiao's side concubine cried and rushed to tell her that she was not the one. Unfortunately, she was not protected by Prince Xiao, but was kicked to the ground by him.

When Prince Xiao's side concubine looked over with tears in her eyes and a look of disbelief on her face, Prince Xiao took the sword from the guard beside him and stabbed her.

In the blink of an eye as life passed by so fast, many things flashed through the mind of Prince Xiao's side concubine, including the prince's gentle words to her, the prince's love for her, the prince's superficial affection for the princess, but secretly he poured Juezi soup into her...

She had always believed that the prince actually loved her, but now she suddenly discovered that the prince had never loved her at all, and she was just a pawn he used.
